item.title: Homeland Security suspends TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The U.S. Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs as a partial government shutdown continues.

item.title: Messi, MLS champs Inter Miami get trounced 3-0 by LAFC in season opener
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Lionel Messi and Inter Miami got off to a rough start in their Major League Soccer Cup title defence when David Martínez, Denis Bouanga and Nathan Ordaz scored in Los Angeles FC's 3-0 victory Saturday night.
